subject: general
question: NIP related to India's budget, which was announced in December 2019 by the Union Finance Minister of India stands for:
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**National Infrastructure Pipeline.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **NIP stands for National Infrastructure Pipeline.**
 
• The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) was announced in **December 2019 by Finance Minister Nirmala Seetharaman.** 
 
• The NIP was launched with 6835 projects; and as Union Budget 2021-22, the project pipeline has now expanded to 7,400 projects. 
 
• Around 217 projects worth Rs. 1.10 lakh crores under some key infrastructure Ministries have been completed.
 
• In the Union Budget 2021-22, the government propose to take the following steps 

 
• by creating the institutional structures; 
 
• by a big thrust on monetizing assets,
 
• by enhancing the share of capital expenditure in central and state budgets.
